desc:
FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Fruit by the Foot Variety Pack featuring Berry Tie-Dye, Blue Raspberry, and Strawberry Tie-Dye flavors; With wild flavors and colors, the possibilities for fun are endless

FUN KIDS SNACK: These individually wrapped snack bags are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box

GLUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats made without gluten, gelatin, or artificial flavors; Contains vitamin C for snacks you can feel great about

ON-THE-GO SNACK: These fruit flavored sheets strips are the perfect addition to your pantry and a snack every member of the family will love

CONTAINS: 4.5 oz, 6 ct
features:
Key Features:

Mixed Snack Types: Includes Fruit Roll-Ups, Fruit by the Foot, and Gushers for a fun variety of flavors and textures.

Gluten & Gelatin Free: Suitable for people with dietary restrictions or food sensitivities.

Vitamin C Enriched: Each pouch provides a small dose of daily Vitamin C.

No Artificial Flavors: Made with natural flavors for a cleaner ingredient list.

Benefits:

Great for On-the-Go: Individually wrapped pouches are perfect for lunchboxes, road trips, or school snacks.

Fun for Kids and Adults: Colorful, chewy, and flavorful – ideal for snack lovers of all ages.

Diet-Friendly: Safe for gluten-sensitive and vegetarian eaters due to the absence of gluten and gelatin.
ingredients: Berry Tie-Dye Ingredients: Sugar, Maltodextrin, Corn Syrup, Pear Puree, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Carrageenan, Monoglycerides, Sodium Citrate, Malic Acid, Xanthan Gum, Locust Bean Gum, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Potassium Citrate, Natural Flavor, Color (red 40, blue 1). Strawberry Tie-Dye Ingredients: Sugar, Maltodextrin, Corn Syrup, Pear Puree, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Carrageenan, Monoglycerides, Sodium Citrate, Malic Acid, Xanthan Gum, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Locust Bean Gum, Potassium Citrate, Natural Flavor, Red 40. Blue Raspberry Tie-Dye Ingredients: Sugar, Maltodextrin, Corn Syrup, Pear Puree, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Carrageenan, Monoglycerides, Sodium Citrate, Malic Acid, Xanthan Gum, Locust Bean Gum, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Potassium Citrate, Natural Flavor, Blue 1.
